# Cadastral Reference

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CadastralReference`](gmeow-CadastralReference.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CadastralReference>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A structured identifier for a land-administration record — a parcel number, folio identifier, title number, lot reference, or survey plan reference issued by a cadastral registry. Carries the reference value, its type, the issuing authority, and the jurisdiction under which it is valid. Temporal validity (re-survey, re-numbering) is carried with [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md) on the reference itself.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a structured land-administration identifier — parcel number, folio, title, lot, or survey-plan reference issued by a registry.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the simple flat link from a place to a bare identifier when value/type/authority/jurisdiction need not be separated, and avoid for the parcel place itself (that is a [`Place`](gmeow-Place.md)).

### How to use

- Mint [`CadastralReference`](gmeow-CadastralReference.md), set the functional [`gmeow:referenceValue`](../properties/gmeow-referenceValue.md), [`gmeow:referenceType`](../properties/gmeow-referenceType.md), [`gmeow:referenceAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-referenceAuthority.md), [`gmeow:referenceJurisdiction`](../properties/gmeow-referenceJurisdiction.md), and link from the place via [`gmeow:hasCadastralReference`](../properties/gmeow-hasCadastralReference.md); carry re-survey validity with [`validFrom`](../properties/gmeow-validFrom.md) / [`validUntil`](../properties/gmeow-validUntil.md).

### Examples

- ex:cr a [`gmeow:CadastralReference`](gmeow-CadastralReference.md); [`gmeow:referenceValue`](../properties/gmeow-referenceValue.md) "Lot 42, Plan 12345"; [`gmeow:referenceAuthority`](../properties/gmeow-referenceAuthority.md) ex:landRegistry.
